description: This file defines the main class 'Daux' responsible for managing the generation of documentation trees, configuration, content types, and output handling within the Daux documentation generator tool. It includes methods for initializing configurations, selecting generators, handling processors, and managing external dependencies.

classes.name: Daux
classes.description: Main class managing configuration, content handling, generator selection, and output for the documentation system.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Generates the documentation tree based on configuration and content.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object, setting up the tree if not already merged.

methods.name: getProcessor
methods.description: Returns the processor instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getGenerators
methods.description: Returns the list of available generators, including extensions.

methods.name: getProcessorClass
methods.description: Determines and returns the class name for the configured processor, validating its existence and inheritance.

methods.name: findAlternatives
methods.description: Finds similar words from a list based on Levenshtein distance.

methods.name: getGenerator
methods.description: Returns the generator instance based on the current configuration, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getContentTypeHandler
methods.description: Returns the content type handler, initializing it if needed.

methods.name: getContentExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of valid content file extensions.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the output interface, defaulting to NullOutput if not set.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a message to the output.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Writes a message followed by a newline to the output.

methods.name: getVerbosity
methods.description: Retrieves the current verbosity level of the output.
